policies.title: Transit-oriented housing
policies.description: HCD explains the state pathway for qualifying housing near specified transit stops. Eligible counties, station tiers and local implementation matter.

policies.title: Environmental-review reforms
policies.description: The 2025 legislation changed CEQA review for specified housing and infrastructure projects. A project’s eligibility must be established separately.

policies.title: Two-unit housing and lot splits
policies.description: Santa Barbara’s official project guidance explains its process for qualifying two-unit housing. Rules and eligibility must be checked with the local planning agency.
